title: Add output token metering to streaming response path (parity with non-streaming)
creator: Nadia Rahman
description:
Context
- Unit Economics dashboard metric (blended $/1M output tokens) depends on accurate output token metering across all response modes.
- We currently have a gap/undercount for streaming responses (SSE / chunked) in at least one code path, causing dashboard under-reporting and reconciliation failures vs billing totals.

Goal
- Ensure output token counts are correctly emitted for streaming responses and match non-streaming behavior within a defined tolerance.

Problem statement
- Non-streaming requests reliably emit `output_tokens` derived from the final generated token sequence.
- Streaming requests may:
  1) emit no `output_tokens` at all (missing field/event), or
  2) emit partial counts (only final chunk), or
  3) double count across retries/reconnects, or
  4) diverge when tool/function-call frames are present.

Scope
- Instrument the streaming path so that for every request we produce the same canonical `output_tokens` as the non-streaming path.
- Include parity for:
  - plain text streaming
  - streaming with tool/function calls
  - early termination (stop reason, user cancel)
  - truncation / max_tokens hit
  - errors where we still streamed partial output

Non-goals
- Changing billing logic in this ticket.
- Adding new dashboard dimensions (handled elsewhere).

Acceptance criteria
1) For a fixed prompt/model/params, streaming and non-streaming output token counts match within +/- 0 tokens for the same underlying generated token IDs (expected in most cases).
2) For tool/function-call streaming frames, `output_tokens` only counts model-generated tokens (not transport/JSON overhead), consistent with non-streaming.
3) No double counting when a streaming request reconnects or the gateway retries a downstream call.
4) Events are emitted for both success and partial-success cases (request terminated after streaming some tokens).
5) Backward compatible with downstream aggregation: field name/type stays consistent (`output_tokens` integer; also keep `streaming=true` dimension).

Implementation plan (high level)
- Source of truth: use model-generated token IDs (decode steps) from the runtime when available; avoid re-tokenizing text deltas in the gateway.
- Emit a single canonical metering event at request end:
  - `output_tokens_total` (or `output_tokens`) computed from total token IDs generated for that request.
  - `streaming=true` tag.
  - Preserve existing dimensions (model, model_version, region, route, customer_tier once available).
- Guardrails:
  - Ensure idempotency on the metering sink (request_id + attempt_id), and only finalize once.
  - If we must support partial finalize (error mid-stream), finalize with what was generated so far and a stop/error reason tag.

Detailed notes / edge cases
- Tool calls: some streaming frames include structured tool call payloads. We must not count JSON wrapper tokens if those are generated post-hoc by the gateway. Only count underlying model output tokens.
- Truncation: if max_tokens is reached, final event should still carry total generated output tokens, stop_reason=max_tokens.
- User cancel: if client disconnects but runtime had already generated N tokens, finalize with N.
- Retries: if gateway retries upstream, ensure that only the successful attempt is billed/metered (or that we label attempts and aggregation chooses the final attempt). For this ticket: enforce “finalize exactly once” for a logical request_id.

Test plan
Unit tests
- Streaming accumulator/finalizer emits output_tokens for:
  - standard streaming completion
  - tool call frames
  - mid-stream error
  - client cancel
- Idempotency: repeated finalize calls do not double emit.

Integration tests (CI)
- Add a golden parity test that runs the same request twice (streaming vs non-streaming) and asserts:
  - output token counts equal
  - stop_reason semantics consistent
- Include at least one test model + quant profile variant used in dogfood (keep small for CI).

Canary/production validation
- Add temporary metrics:
  - `metering.streaming_output_tokens_missing_rate`
  - `metering.streaming_vs_nonstreaming_token_delta_p50/p99` (sampled)
- Validate on a small internal traffic slice for 24h before broad rollout.

Rollout notes
- Roll out behind a runtime/gateway flag: `metering_streaming_output_tokens_v2`.
- Steps:
  1) Enable in staging + run replay tests.
  2) Enable for internal dogfood routes only.
  3) Enable 5% hosted traffic, monitor missing rate + deltas.
  4) Ramp to 100% if stable.
- Coordinate with Unit Economics aggregation job owners to confirm downstream views treat streaming correctly after change.

Links
- Related incident thread: sources/slack/eng-platform/1737849033-output-token-metering-streaming-bug.json
- Customer ticket signal: SUP-28501-streaming-output-token-metering-under-count
- PR (implementation): sources/github/redwood/pr-19355-streaming-output-token-metering-fix.json
- Follow-up tests ticket: ENG-8437-add-tests-for-output-token-metering-regressions

Owner(s)
- Primary: Jada Williams
- Reviewer(s): Nadia Rahman (metering), Logan Wright (telemetry pipeline), Sean Gallagher (SRE for rollout/monitoring)
comments: 2025-01-16 (Nadia Rahman): Marking P0. Finance needs QTD numbers and streaming is a large share of tokens for chat routes. Current undercount is blocking reconciliation work (ENG-8430).

2025-01-18 (Jada Williams): Root cause seems to be the streaming responder path bypassing the final metering finalizer when the connection closes normally (SSE end) vs non-streaming code path that always runs the post-hook. Plan: move output token count emission to the request lifecycle finalizer that runs regardless of streaming transport.

2025-01-22 (Sean Gallagher): Please ensure we emit something for partial streams (client disconnect). From an SRE perspective, “missing metering event” is worse than “partial tokens with stop_reason=client_disconnect”. Add a counter for finalize paths.

2025-01-27 (Jada Williams): Implementation in PR-19355: use runtime-provided generated_token_count on finalize; if unavailable, fall back to tokenizer on concatenated deltas (sampled + debug-only) to avoid huge CPU overhead. Added request_id+attempt_id idempotency key to prevent double emits on reconnect. Added stop_reason tags for max_tokens/client_disconnect/error.

2025-01-30 (Nadia Rahman): Reviewed. Please add one integration test that includes a tool call frame; we’ve previously seen tool-call-only responses report 0 output tokens. OK to land without it if ENG-8437 is guaranteed this week, but we need coverage before full ramp.

2025-02-02 (Jada Williams): Tool-call parity test added (minimal) + updated docs in PR description. Staging looks good; missing_rate dropped from ~3.8% to <0.1% on internal traffic. Delta p99 is 0 tokens for sampled parity runs.
2025-02-05 (Logan Wright): Rolled to 25% hosted traffic overnight; no increase in metering pipeline errors. Proceeding to 100% today. Marking Done after ramp completes.
